items.title: Keep the family's field
items.saying: {hero.name} kept the field through lean years. The plough handle is worn where their hands held it.

items.title: Buy the family free of the lord's due
items.saying: {hero.name} paid the last due. Our name is no longer written under another person's hand.

items.title: Keep the children fed
items.saying: When winter came, {hero.name} kept food in the house. The children remember the bread before the fear.

items.title: See the sea
items.saying: {hero.name} followed the road until the water had no farther bank. The field was never quite the edge of the world again.

items.title: Build a marriage chosen for love
items.saying: {hero.name} made a household with someone who chose to stay. That is the part of the house we still live in.

items.title: Be a neighbour worth keeping
items.saying: When the ditch rose and the roofs failed, {hero.name} crossed the boundary with willing hands. The houses beside ours still remember.
